title: Incorrect boundary conditions in the Libraries component in NSS
description: CVE-2026-12318 is a vulnerability in the Libraries component of Microsoft software version 4.0 involving incorrect boundary conditions. The issue relates to a CWE-119 type flaw, which typically involves improper handling of memory boundaries. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. No patch or remediation details are available from the vendor at this time.
